_note: Video pipeline: a pothole detector scans the drive video, every confirmed detection opens a window [t - before_s, t + after_s], overlapping windows merge, and LingBot-Map turns each window into 3D.

frames._note: Band of the frame given to LingBot (fractions of height). LingBot centre-crops tall frames to a square, which would cut the road off a portrait phone video; 'auto' keeps a square band low in the frame for portrait video and the full frame for landscape.
frames._fps_note: Frames per second given to LingBot. 5 fps keeps a 20 s clip near 100 frames, which fits a 16 GB GPU; raise it on a bigger GPU.

lingbot._env_note: Extra environment for the LingBot process. On this NixOS machine the conda matplotlib needs the system FreeType preloaded; update the path if the Nix store changes (ls -d /nix/store/*-freetype-*/lib/libfreetype.so.6).
lingbot._extra_args_note: Settings that fit LingBot-Map on this 16 GB RTX 5080 next to the desktop (tested 2026-11-14: 109 frames in 22 s): bf16_weights runs batch_demo.py through adapters/lingbot_lowmem.py (bfloat16 backbone, depth head in chunks of 2 frames); smaller KV cache and 4 scale frames; --use_sdpa because FlashInfer needs nvcc to compile kernels for the smaller cache. On a 24 GB+ GPU remove these for the authors' defaults.

scale._note: LingBot output is not metric. Scale comes from gps.csv (t, lat, lon from the video start) or, without GPS, from the camera height above the road.

perspective._note: Road-plane perspective transform (cv2.getPerspectiveTransform + warpPerspective). src: 4 points on the road in the FULL video frame, as fractions of width/height, in the order top-left, bottom-left, bottom-right, top-right. They must be the corners of a real rectangle on the road of width_m x length_m whose near edge is near_m ahead of the camera. Defaults are UNCALIBRATED guesses for a forward-facing camera; run `civil calibrate` to set them.

analysis._note: Analysis settings for LingBot clips. surface_window_m fits the road surface in 8 m windows so reconstruction drift along the walk doesn't become fake potholes (found on the Rangoon Road test, 2026-11-14). 0 = one fit per segment.
